description: Transform all UI primitives (button, card, badge, input, select, table, dialog, tabs, toggle-switch, skeleton, avatar, dropdown-menu, separator, sheet, label, form) to Apple design system standards. Each component must use Apple colors, typography, border radius (10-20px), multi-layer soft shadows, proper icon sizing (20px Lucide icons with strokeWidth=2), spring animations, and iOS/macOS interaction patterns.
steps: Update components/ui/button.tsx: Change default height to 44px (h-11), rounded-xl (12px), font-size 15-16px medium weight, primary bg-[#007AFF], hover scale(0.98) with shadow transition (NOT color darkening), destructive bg-[#FF3B30], outline border-[#E5E5EA], secondary bg-[#F2F2F7], ghost hover:bg-[#F2F2F7], use spring animation (transition-all duration-200 cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)). Icon size 20px. Remove active:scale-[0.97], use hover:scale-[0.98] instead

Update components/ui/card.tsx: rounded-2xl (20px), border-[0.5px] or border (1px) #E5E5EA, shadow to use --apple-shadow-card or Tailwind equivalent (shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04),0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03),0_4px_16px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]), hover:shadow-elevated and translateY(-2px), padding 16-20px, CardTitle font-semibold 17-19px with letter-spacing -0.022em

Update components/ui/badge.tsx: Full rounded-full (or rounded-xl 12px for pill), 10-12px font medium, padding px-3 py-1, colors with 10% opacity backgrounds (bg-[#007AFF]/10 text-[#007AFF], bg-[#34C759]/10 text-[#34C759], bg-[#FF3B30]/10 text-[#FF3B30], bg-[#FF9500]/10 text-[#FF9500]), border-transparent, no harsh borders

Update components/ui/input.tsx: height 44px (h-11), rounded-xl (12px), border #E5E5EA (1px), bg-[#FBFBFD], placeholder text-[#8E8E93], focus:ring-2 ring-[#007AFF] with subtle blue shadow (shadow-[0_0_0_3px_rgba(0,122,255,0.1)]), font 15-16px, letter-spacing -0.016em

Update components/ui/select.tsx: SelectTrigger height 44px rounded-xl border-[#E5E5EA] bg-[#FBFBFD] placeholder:text-[#8E8E93], focus:ring-2 ring-[#007AFF], SelectContent rounded-xl border-[#E5E5EA] shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)], SelectItem hover:bg-[#F2F2F7] rounded-lg, Check icon 20px strokeWidth=2, ChevronDown 20px

Update components/ui/table.tsx: Remove grid borders, row separator border-b border-[#E5E5EA] (1px), NO zebra stripes, TableHead text-[#8E8E93] font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wide, TableRow hover:bg-[#F9F9FB], padding py-3 px-4, cell font 14-15px

Update components/ui/dialog.tsx: DialogContent rounded-2xl (20px), border-[#E5E5EA], shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)], padding p-6, DialogOverlay bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-sm, DialogTitle font-semibold 19px letter-spacing -0.022em, Close button (X) 20px icon rounded-lg hover:bg-[#F2F2F7]

Update components/ui/tabs.tsx: TabsList rounded-xl bg-[#F2F2F7] padding p-1, TabsTrigger rounded-lg (10px) px-4 py-2 text-[#8E8E93] font-medium 15px, active:bg-white text-[#1C1C1E] shadow-sm (subtle), transition-all 200ms spring

Update components/ui/toggle-switch.tsx: Already Apple-style. Verify knob size, track colors (bg-[#E5E5EA] off, bg-[#007AFF] on), smooth transition 200ms, sizes correct (md: track 51x31px, knob 27px; sm: track 38x22px, knob 18px). Ensure colors match Apple guidelines (blue #007AFF, green #34C759, orange #FF9500)
Update components/ui/skeleton.tsx: rounded-xl, bg-[#F2F2F7] or bg-[#E5E5EA]/50, animate-pulse with spring timing
Update components/ui/avatar.tsx (if exists, else skip): rounded-full, border-[#E5E5EA]

Update components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx: DropdownMenuContent rounded-xl border-[#E5E5EA] shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)], DropdownMenuItem hover:bg-[#F2F2F7] rounded-lg text-[#1C1C1E] 15px, icons 20px
Update components/ui/separator.tsx: bg-[#E5E5EA], height 1px (horizontal) or width 1px (vertical)
Update components/ui/sheet.tsx (if exists): Similar to dialog - rounded corners, Apple shadows, border-[#E5E5EA]
Update components/ui/form.tsx (if exists): Match input and label styles, error messages text-[#FF3B30] 13px

Update components/ui/toast.tsx and toaster.tsx: rounded-xl border-[#E5E5EA] shadow-elevated, success bg-[#34C759]/10 border-[#34C759], error bg-[#FF3B30]/10 border-[#FF3B30], info bg-[#007AFF]/10 border-[#007AFF]
Ensure all Lucide icons across ALL UI components are sized at 20px (w-5 h-5) with strokeWidth=2 (if prop available) and rounded stroke-linecap
acceptance_criteria: All UI primitives use Apple color palette (#007AFF blue, #34C759 green, #FF3B30 red, #FF9500 orange, #8E8E93 gray, #E5E5EA borders)
Border radius matches Apple standards (10-12px small, 16-20px cards, 24px large containers)
Shadows are multi-layer soft (no harsh single-layer shadows)
All interactive elements have spring animations (cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), 200-300ms)
Buttons use scale(0.98) on hover, NOT color darkening
All icons are 20px Lucide icons (w-5 h-5)
Inputs and selects are 44px tall with proper focus rings (2px #007AFF)
Tables have no grid borders, only row separators
No build errors, all TypeScript types pass
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm no errors
Run 'npm run dev' and visually inspect each UI component on any page
Test button hover states - should scale down slightly, not change color
Test input/select focus - should show blue ring with subtle shadow
Test dialog/modal - should have soft shadow and proper border radius
Verify all icons are uniform 20px size
Check table borders - should only have horizontal row separators
Test toggle switch - smooth animation, correct colors
findings:
Successfully transformed all UI primitives to Apple design system standards. Updated 17 component files:

1. button.tsx: Changed to h-11 (44px), text-[15px], icons 20px (w-5 h-5), hover:scale-[0.98] with shadow transitions (removed color darkening), spring animation cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)
2. card.tsx: Applied rounded-2xl, Apple shadows with hover elevation effect, padding adjusted to p-5, CardTitle to text-[19px] with tracking-[-0.022em]
3. badge.tsx: Full rounded-full, px-3 py-1, all variants use 10% opacity backgrounds (bg-[#007AFF]/10, bg-[#34C759]/10, bg-[#FF3B30]/10, bg-[#FF9500]/10), added success and warning variants
4. input.tsx: h-11, rounded-xl, bg-[#FBFBFD], text-[15px] tracking-[-0.016em], placeholder:text-[#8E8E93], focus ring with shadow-[0_0_0_3px_rgba(0,122,255,0.1)], transition-all duration-200
5. select.tsx: SelectTrigger h-11 bg-[#FBFBFD] with focus ring and shadow, all icons updated to 20px (h-5 w-5) with strokeWidth={2}, SelectItem text-[15px] hover:bg-[#F2F2F7], rounded-xl borders
6. table.tsx: Removed grid borders from TableHeader, TableRow border-b border-[#E5E5EA], hover:bg-[#F9F9FB], TableHead font-semibold with py-3, TableCell text-[14px] py-3
7. dialog.tsx: DialogOverlay with backdrop-blur-sm, DialogContent shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)], Close button rounded-lg hover:bg-[#F2F2F7] with 20px icon, DialogTitle text-[19px] tracking-[-0.022em]
8. tabs.tsx: TabsTrigger px-4 py-2 text-[15px], transition-all duration-200 with spring timing
9. skeleton.tsx: rounded-xl bg-[#F2F2F7]
10. avatar.tsx: Added border border-[#E5E5EA]
11. dropdown-menu.tsx: All content rounded-xl shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)], items rounded-lg text-[15px] hover:bg-[#F2F2F7], all icons 20px (h-5 w-5) with strokeWidth={2}
12. separator.tsx: bg-[#E5E5EA] h-[1px] or w-[1px]
13. sheet.tsx: SheetOverlay backdrop-blur-sm, all variants with rounded corners (rounded-2xl), shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)], Close button 20px icon, SheetTitle text-[19px] tracking-[-0.022em]
14. label.tsx: text-[15px] tracking-[-0.016em] text-[#1C1C1E]
15. form.tsx: FormMessage text-[13px] text-[#FF3B30]
16. toast.tsx: rounded-xl shadow-elevated, added success/info variants with 10% opacity backgrounds, Close button 20px icon rounded-lg hover:bg-[#F2F2F7]
17. toggle-switch.tsx: Already Apple-style, verified colors and sizing

All components now use:
- Apple color palette (#007AFF, #34C759, #FF3B30, #FF9500, #8E8E93, #E5E5EA)
- Apple border radius (10-20px)
- Multi-layer soft shadows
- Spring animations (cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), 200ms)
- Uniform 20px icons (w-5 h-5) with strokeWidth=2
- Buttons use scale(0.98) on hover, not color darkening
- Inputs/selects 44px tall with proper focus rings
- Tables with row separators only, no grid borders

Build completed successfully with no TypeScript errors. All acceptance criteria met.
